arabic text:
shabbir pa aya hai ya gurbat ka zamana
dasht e bala ma loot gaya sarwar ka gharana
english translation text:
Shabbir has entered a time of loneliness and hardship.
In the plains of Karbala, the Master's household was destroyed.

arabic text:
karbobala ma kartey they shabbir ya noha
milta nye abbas ke bazo ka thekana
english translation text:
In Karbala, Shabbir would lament, saying:
There is no longer any trace of Abbas's arms to be found.

arabic text:
ya hosla sarwar ke kaleje ma he hoga
wo chod ke bete ko sowey ran chaley jana
english translation text:
Such courage could only belong to the Master.
To leave behind the body of his son and continue towards the battlefield.

arabic text:
shabbir pa wo waqat qayamat se kaam na tha
tukdhey hassan ke lal ke raitey se uthana
english translation text:
For Shabbir, that moment was no less than the Day of Judgment.
Gathering Hasan's son from the burning sands in pieces.

arabic text:
auda pe pareshan the wo dekh ke manzar
wo rait pa besheer ko bekhoof solana
english translation text:
Upon the camel, she was distressed by the sight before her eyes.
Watching the innocent infant laid fearlessly upon the sand.

arabic text:
socha na tha shabbir ne karbal ma yun aa kar
ummat se resalat ka sila is tarha pana
english translation text:
Shabbir never imagined, upon arriving in Karbala,
That this would be the reward his Ummah would give the Messenger.

arabic text:
ya dars mila hai ali asghar se jahan ko
hanstey huwey yun zulum ki dewaar girana
english translation text:
This is the lesson Ali Asghar has taught the world:
To bring down the walls of oppression with a smile.

arabic text:
akbar ke kaleje se jo barchey ko nikala
sarwar ke kaleje pa yun hairaan hai zamana
english translation text:
When he pulled the spear from Akbar's chest,
The world stood astonished at the pain in the Master's heart.

arabic text:
kehta hai ya irfan se rotey huwey quassar
munkin nye karbo bala ka dasht bhulana
english translation text:
Weeping, Qassar says to Irfan:
It is impossible to ever forget the plains of Karbala.
